verdict.rationale: An app-level biometric or PIN lock is a fair question for a password manager with mobile apps, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents Proton Pass locking itself behind biometrics, a PIN, or any app-lock or auto-lock setting. The TOTP, passkey and encryption material covers different capabilities and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
